mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 77 degrees under partly cloudy skies near Harriet Park. The moon is currently in a waxing gibbous phase. Also, look up at 9:37 PM tonight to catch the space station as it moves from the direction of Cross Plains toward Oregon, climbing to about halfway up the sky.

Regarding city news, the I Voted sticker contest for K through 12 students has officially closed for submissions. The community is invited to view the designs and vote for their favorites starting July 28 through August 7. Winning designs will be featured on official stickers for the November election.

We have a busy schedule of events. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the State Capitol, or enjoy live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for Yoga at Insight Wellness this Sunday, followed by trivia nights starting Monday at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident from July 13 where a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O-W-I offense after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.

Today is the day to enjoy the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor at Culver's. They are open until 10:30 PM, so you still have plenty of time to stop by for a treat. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be OREO Cookie Overload.
